orders.text:
WPMS No.1536 of 2023
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Senior 
Advocate assisted by Mr. Subhang 
Dobhal, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. V.D. Bisen, Brief Holder for 
the State. 
It is the case of the petitioner 
that they are owner of the property 
which has been wrongly transferred 
in contravention to Section 154 of 
The U.P. Zamindari Abolition and 
Land Reforms Act, 1950 as 
amended by the Uttarakhand 
Zamindari Abolition and Land 
Reforms (Amendment) Act, 2016 (for 
short, “the Act”). When the 
petitioner came to know about this 
illegality, they moved an application 
for cancellation of those deeds in 
view of Section 154 of the Act.
It is argued that, in fact, 
similar order has been passed by 
the Collector. Reference has been 
made to Annexure No.8.
Learned counsel for the 
petitioner gives a statement that, in 
fact, such application under Section 
154 of the Act has been given in the 
month of November, 2022. 
The Court wanted to know 
from the learned State counsel, as 
to what action has been taken on 
his complaint. He seeks time. List on 23.06.2023, just after 
fresh cases. 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 15.06.2023
Sanjay

SL.

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No.1536 of 2023
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, Advocate for the petitioners.
2. Mr. M.S. Bisht, B.H. for the State.
3. Mr. P.K. Chauhan, Advocate for the Intervener￾applicant.
4. Vide order dated 15.06.2023, passed by Co-ordinate 
Bench of this Court, instructions were sought from the State 
counsel to find out that as to what action has been taken by the 
Collector, on the application moved by the petitioner under 
Section 154 of the U.P.Z.A. and L.R. Act, 1950 amended upto 
date.
5. Learned State counsel, on instructions, submitted that 
the application moved by the petitioners has been sent to the 
Land Fraud Committee headed by Commissioner Garhwal 
Division.
6. But, learned State counsel has no information that as to 
what action has been taken by the said Committee on the said 
application.
7. Learned State counsel seeks further two weeks’ time to 
find out that as to what further action has been taken by the 
Land Fraud Committee.
8. List this case on 20.11.2024.
9. In the meantime, petitioner may file objection to the 
intervention application.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 22.10.2024
SK 2
